intent: PSI-002: strip Clerk and the unused template demos, keep kanban, chat, ai-chat and notifications, and leave a template that builds and boots without any auth keys.
summary: Two agent sessions worked this task in sequence on branch task/PSI-002. Session A (a separate Claude session, 03:35 to about 03:40Z, no history entry of its own; its model is unknown) claimed PSI-002 and did the bulk of the work, uncommitted: removed the Clerk dependency (@clerk/nextjs) and its env block, replaced src/proxy.ts with a pass-through, deleted the demo features (products, users, forms, auth, react-query-demo, profile, elements) with their pages, API routes and mock data, removed the org switcher and user-avatar components, trimmed nav-config, use-nav and the breadcrumbs, and pointed the notification links that targeted removed pages (workspaces, product, billing) at /dashboard/overview, and adjusted README, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, Dockerfiles, deployment docs and next.config.ts. Session B (this entry's author, from 03:52Z) found the work idle for 13 minutes with no running processes, checked what was left, and took it over at the operator's request (PSI-002 is the critical path: it gates PSI-005, PSI-008 and PSI-010). One Clerk import and an auth.protect() call were still in src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx; session B removed both, which was the only code edit needed. Then all acceptance checks were run: no @clerk in package.json, typecheck, lint and build pass, and every kept route returns 200 in the dev server. This also fixes PSI-001's failing boot check (every page used to return 500 'Missing publishableKey'). Sentry was kept on purpose (PSI-093 decides). Nothing was committed by either session at the time of this entry, and nothing was pushed.
